title: RegEx Explorer library
description: The saved regexes of RegEx Explorer, as stored in regexes.json in the app's Application Support folder. See docs/storage-format.md.

$schema.description: The URL of the schema the file follows.

version.description: The file format version. Later releases use it to migrate older files.

regexes.description: The saved regexes, in the order the sidebar lists them.

savedRegex.description: A named, reusable regular expression with its sample text and options. Only id and name are required; the app uses the default for any other missing field.

id.description: A UUID that identifies the regex.

name.description: The name shown in the sidebar, such as "Email Address".

pattern.description: The regular expression, in Swift Regex syntax.

sampleText.description: The text the pattern is tried against.

mode.description: Which result the editor shows. The app reads an unknown mode as match.

replacement.description: The Replace mode template: $0 is the whole match, $1 or ${1} a group, ${name} a named group, and $$ a dollar sign.

invertsFilter.description: In Filter mode, keep the lines without a match instead of those with one.

createdAt.description: When the regex was created, as an ISO 8601 date and time.

modifiedAt.description: When the regex was last changed, as an ISO 8601 date and time. Defaults to createdAt.

options.description: Settings applied when the pattern is compiled. A missing option is off.

anchorsMatchLineEndings.description: ^ and $ match at the start and end of every line, not just the whole text.

allowsExtendedSyntax.description: Whitespace in the pattern is ignored and # starts a comment.

usesSimpleWordBoundaries.description: \b uses simple word-character transitions instead of Unicode word rules.
